title: FanDuel owner Flutter plans to delist its London shares on August 3, citing low trading and high costs; Flutter moved its primary listing to the US in 2024 (Lauren Almeida/The Guardian)
summary: Lauren Almeida / The Guardian: FanDuel owner Flutter plans to delist its London shares on August 3, citing low trading and high costs; Flutter moved its primary listing to the US in 2024 — Gambling business, which also owns Betfair, to focus on New York in latest high-profile blow to UK stock market
